title: Changing a contact phone number
aliases: edit phone number of a customer
body:
Imported from wiki page 'contacts_howto_v3'.

To change a contact's phone number, find the person in Contacts and open them. Press Edit, type the new number in the Phone field and press Save. If the number has an extension, put it after the main number with an x.

If you have a lot of numbers to change, ask your admin to use the importer with the Update existing option. Make sure the email column is filled in, otherwise the importer cannot match people. Don't confuse this with the company phone, which is edited on the Company page.

title: Staff note: contact export limits
body:
STAFF ONLY - do not paste to customers.

Export to CSV fails silently for clients with more than about 10k contacts when the job runs during the nightly backup (01:00 to 03:00 server time). Workaround: ask the client to export in two halves using a filter on Created date, or have engineering run the export for them and attach it to the ticket.

See ticket HB-2291. Some clients on the oldest plan still hit the 48 hour link expiry. Remember the client is the account holder; their contacts are their customers, so check consent before sending any file.

title: Deleting a company record
body:
Wiki import, author unknown.

Open Companies and click the company name. Click the three dots and choose Delete. You will be asked whether to keep the people linked to it. Choose Keep contacts unless you really want them gone as well.

Deals linked to the company stay in the pipeline, but the company name turns grey. If the Delete option is missing you are probably not an administrator. Ask the owner of the client account to either give you the role or do the delete themselves. Deleted companies cannot be brought back, so export first if unsure.

title: Billing email changes (support cheat sheet)
aliases: who can change the billing email
body:
Cheat sheet copied from the support wiki.

Customer asks to change the billing email: the request must come from the account owner. Check the sender address matches the owner on file. Then in the admin console open the client, go to Billing, edit Billing email and save.

A confirmation email goes to the new address. If they say they never got it, check spam, then resend. Do not change it on a request from a contact of the client, since that is the client's customer, not the account holder. Log everything in the ticket notes before closing.

title: Closing a lost deal
body:
Open the deal and click Lost near the top right. A small window asks for a reason. Pick the closest one, or choose Other and write a few words. Click Confirm.

The deal moves out of your open pipeline and into the Lost report, so your forecast numbers change straight away. If you clicked the wrong button, use Reopen from the three dots menu. People often ask whether lost deals count towards revenue. They do not.

title: Changing an employee's phone number
aliases: update contact details for a team member
body:
From the old HR wiki.

Go to People, search for the name and open the profile. On the Contact tab press Edit and update Mobile or Work phone. Press Save.

If you are an employee and the Edit button is greyed out, your HR manager has turned off self-service for contact details. Please ask them to do it. Phone changes do not alter payroll records. If someone's emergency contact changes too, use the Personal tab, which is a separate section.

title: Sending a payment reminder
body:
Wiki import.

Open the invoice that is overdue and click Send reminder. Choose a message from the list or write your own, then click Send. The customer gets an email with a link to view and pay the invoice.

You can see when reminders went out in the Activity panel. To stop getting asked about this, set up automatic reminders in Settings under Reminders, where you can send one 3 days before the due date and another 7 days after.

Note: the wording of the default templates was last updated by finance in 2022.

title: Making a campaign step by step
body:
Imported from marketing wiki, no metadata.

Click Campaigns, then New. Give it a name that only you will see, then a subject line your readers will see. Choose a list to send to. Write your message, adding images if you like. Always click Send test and look at it on your phone before sending to everyone.

Pick Send now or choose a date and time. If your list is over 2,000 people, schedule the send for off-peak hours so delivery is smooth. Check the Reports tab the next day for opens and clicks.

title: Internal: ticket assignment etiquette
body:
INTERNAL - team leads only.

When you assign a ticket to a colleague, add an internal note explaining what has been tried. Do not assign to someone who is marked Away without checking with the team lead first. Urgent tickets must always be assigned to a named person, not a team, so someone is accountable.

To assign: open the ticket, select Assignee in the side panel, choose the person, then Assign. Customers never see assignee names unless the signature setting is on. Review this page in Q3.

title: Creating a new project
aliases: make a project and invite team
body:
Old wiki article, author left the company.

Click New and pick Project. Type a name, choose whether it is Private or visible to everyone, and add the people who will work on it. You can start empty or copy the layout of a previous project. Click Create.

After creating it, add your first tasks and set a due date for each. Members get an email when they are added. If a person does not receive it, check that their address is correct in People. Projects can be renamed at any time from Settings inside the project.
